description: Job alerts: new job openings since a time, for monitoring (e.g. new remote engineering roles): jobs first seen by a twice-daily crawl of about 20,000 company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday). Same filters as /jobs/search (title, company, location, remote, minimum salary). Returns up to 50 newest, each with when it was first seen, and nextSince for the next poll. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay, in currency; only jobs that publish pay

since.description: ISO 8601 time or Unix seconds; older than 30 days counts as 30 days ago

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives

name: jobs_new
